name: Link Scanner
author: Patrick O'Donoghue

sections.description:
Simple Link Scanner – Lightweight, Unlimited Link Scanning for WordPress

Looking for a fast and reliable way to scan all the links on your WordPress site — without the bloat? Simple Link Scanner does exactly that. No SEO noise, no complicated dashboards — just a clean, categorized list of every link on your site.

✅ What It Does

Scan unlimited posts, pages, and links — whether it’s 50 or 100,000
View clear results categorized as:
Successful
Redirected
Link Failed (with specific error codes)

Works across all post types, including pages and custom content
Built for performance and simplicity

🧭 How It Works

Download and install from the plugin directory
Click “Link Scanner” in your dashboard
Wait for the scan to complete and view your results — it’s that easy

💡 Use Cases

Quickly check for broken or redirected links
Audit internal and external links across your site
Keep track of content performance and user experience
Perfect for content creators, site managers, and developers

💬 A Note from the Creator

Hi! I’m Patrick O’Donoghue from odonodesign.com. I built this plugin to be fast, simple, and helpful — without the unnecessary extras. It’s free to use for anyone scanning links on their WordPress site.

If you find it useful and want to support future development, please consider donating via PayPal:

👉 https://bit.ly/4dvtZtS

Your support is genuinely appreciated.

🚀 Ready to Go?

Install Simple Link Scanner, scan your site, and get a clean overview of your links — all with just a few clicks.

No learning curve. No bloat. Just fast, effective results.

Happy scanning!

A brief Markdown Example

Markdown is what the parser uses to process much of the readme file.

List of features:

  1. Scan unlimited posts and pages to find ALL urls.
  2. It will categorise each url as either “successful”, “redirected” or “link failed” to show what the status of your url is on that page.
  3. Will allow you to see easily how all the links on your posts are doing and whether any are broken.
